info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Model Liquidity Risk Models-spec
info.description: The Liquidity Risk Models Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of liquidity risk models utilized within the banking sector. This API serves financial analysts and risk managers who require up-to-date model information to assess liquidity exposure and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can efficiently retrieve model specifications and associated data to inform decision-making processes. It supports a seamless integration for applications focused on risk assessment and management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of all available liquidity risk models, providing insights into their characteristics and performance metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body specifies the parameters for retrieving liquidity risk models. It should include all necessary fields and adhere to the schema defined for the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of liquidity risk models.

ListModelLiquidityRiskModelsRequest.description: Represents the JSON request body for the liquidity risk models operations GET request. It is expected to be a string representation of the request data.

items.description: An array of liquidity risk model objects.

sort.description: Sort order applied to the models returned.

ListModelLiquidityRiskModelsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the liquidity risk models operations GET request.

modelId.description: The unique identifier for the liquidity risk model.

modelVersion.description: The version of the liquidity risk model.

portfolioId.description: The identifier of the portfolio related to the liquidity risk model.

asOfDate.description: The date as of which the model is valid.

scenario.description: The scenario for which the liquidity risk model is being applied.

confidenceLevel.description: The confidence level associated with the model's predictions.

validationDatasetId.description: Identifier for the dataset used for validation of the model.

backtestWindowMonths.description: The window of months used for backtesting the model.

approvalStatus.description: The approval status of the liquidity risk model.

recordStatus.description: The current record status of the model in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the model was last updated.

LiquidityRiskModel.description: Represents an individual liquidity risk model.

page.description: The current page number of the results.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

totalItems.description: The total number of items available across all pages.

Pagination.description: Metadata for pagination of the returned results.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A correlation identifier for tracing requests across services.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. It requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) to be included in the request headers for authorization. The token should be prefixed with the word 'Bearer', followed by a space.
